name: What is the typical timeline for incorporating custom outdoor storage into an outdoor living project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for incorporating custom outdoor storage into an outdoor living project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for incorporating custom outdoor storage is an integral part of your overall outdoor living project schedule. From initial design and material selection to construction and final installation, we provide a managed process with clear communication on scheduling. While smaller integrated units might add minimal time, extensive built-ins with complex finishes will be factored into the comprehensive project timeline, often running concurrently with other construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom outdoor storage is integrated into the overall outdoor living project timeline, with clear communication provided during our managed design-build process.
